# free

Print Linux system RAM and swap statistics.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/free -wt
```

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-b`, `--bytes` | Print bytes. |
| `-k`, `--kibi` | Print kibibytes. |
| `-m`, `--mebi` | Print mebibytes. |
| `-g`, `--gibi` | Print gibibytes. |
| `-w`, `--wide` | Show buffers and cache separately. |
| `-t`, `--total` | Include RAM and swap totals. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Uses a single /proc/meminfo snapshot with MemAvailable and SReclaimable. Reports kernel-wide RAM, including reclaimable slab, and swap. Values are independent of cgroup memory limits.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
